title: skill frontmatter
description: The frontmatter of a skill file, which rbtv reads and validates. The file's body follows the template skill.md.

name.description: The skill's name, the same as its file name without `.md`.

description.description: First sentence enough to decide whether to open the skill; then the situations that should open it, including one that does not use the skill's name, and one similar task that must not.
